changelog.body: **What's new in 3.5** The app list on the tablet is easier to use: - **Search:** A search box at the top of the app list. Type a name to find an app quickly. - **Turn all off:** A new button at the top right turns every app off at once. It asks first. - **Refresh icon:** The "Refresh from phone" row is now a refresh icon at the top right. Tap it after installing new apps on your phone. - **List info:** The number of apps and the last update time are shown under the title. | App list | Search | Turn all off | |---|---|---| | | | | **Updating from 3.3?** After updating, LSPosed shows a "Scope request" notification once. Tap **Approve** and restart the tablet, so notifications pop up on the screen. --- **What XNotify does** See your Xiaomi phone's notifications on your Xiaomi tablet, from any app. Without XNotify, HyperOS only does this for a few Chinese apps like WeChat and QQ. **What you get** - Notifications from any app on your phone: Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, SMS, calls and more - Notifications pop up on the tablet screen - You choose on the tablet which apps to receive, from a list with icons and search - Each notification shows the app icon, the app name and which phone it came from - Works while you use your phone, not only when it is locked - Works with Xiaomi accounts from any country **What you need** - A Xiaomi phone and a Xiaomi tablet, both on the HyperOS 4 China ROM - Both signed in to the same Xiaomi account, with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on - Root and LSPosed on both devices **How to set it up** 1. Install XNotify on the phone and on the tablet. 2. Turn it on in LSPosed on both devices, then restart both. 3. On the tablet, go to Settings → Interconnectivity → Notifications → Receive. 4. Tap your phone and turn on the apps you want.

**What's new in 3.4**
- Notifications now pop up at the top of the tablet screen, even while you watch a video or use another app. Before, they only appeared in the notification shade.

**Updating from 3.3?**
After updating, LSPosed shows a "Scope request" notification once. Tap **Approve** and restart the tablet. If you skip it, everything still works, but notifications won't pop up.

---

**What XNotify does**

See your Xiaomi phone's notifications on your Xiaomi tablet, from any app. Without XNotify, HyperOS only does this for a few Chinese apps like WeChat and QQ.

**What you get**
- Notifications from any app on your phone: Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, SMS, calls and more
- Notifications pop up on the tablet screen
- You choose on the tablet which apps to receive, from a list with icons
- Each notification shows the app icon, the app name and which phone it came from
- Works while you use your phone, not only when it is locked
- Works with Xiaomi accounts from any country

**What you need**
- A Xiaomi phone and a Xiaomi tablet, both on the HyperOS 4 China ROM
- Both signed in to the same Xiaomi account, with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on
- Root and LSPosed on both devices

**How to set it up**
1. Install XNotify on the phone and on the tablet.
2. Turn it on in LSPosed on both devices, then restart both.
3. On the tablet, go to Settings → Interconnectivity → Notifications → Receive.
4. Tap your phone and turn on the apps you want.

**First release**

See your Xiaomi phone's notifications on your Xiaomi tablet, from any app. Without XNotify, HyperOS only does this for a few Chinese apps like WeChat and QQ.

**What you get**
- Notifications from any app on your phone: Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, SMS, calls and more
- You choose on the tablet which apps to receive, from a list with icons
- Each notification shows the app icon, the app name and which phone it came from
- Works while you use your phone, not only when it is locked
- Works with Xiaomi accounts from any country

**What you need**
- A Xiaomi phone and a Xiaomi tablet, both on the HyperOS 4 China ROM
- Both signed in to the same Xiaomi account, with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on
- Root and LSPosed on both devices

**How to set it up**
1. Install XNotify on the phone and on the tablet.
2. Turn it on in LSPosed on both devices, then restart both.
3. On the tablet, go to Settings → Interconnectivity → Notifications → Receive.
4. Tap your phone and turn on the apps you want.

readme: # XNotify **See your Xiaomi phone's notifications on your Xiaomi tablet, from every app.** An LSPosed module for the HyperOS 4 China ROM. [Türkçe açıklama aşağıda](#türkçe) ## Why HyperOS can show phone notifications on a tablet, but it has three limits: - Only a few Chinese apps are supported (WeChat, QQ, DingTalk…). - The China tablet ROM hides the **Receive** tab, where you choose which phone and which apps to receive notifications from. - It only works with Xiaomi accounts registered in China. XNotify removes all three. ## Features - ✅ **Every app:** Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, SMS, calls and anything else installed on the phone. - ✅ **Receive tab unlocked:** Settings → Interconnectivity → Notifications now shows the **Receive** tab on the tablet. - ✅ **App picker with icons:** The phone sends its app list and icons to the tablet. After installing new apps, tap the refresh icon at the top right. - ✅ **Search and turn all off:** Find an app by typing its name, or turn every app off with one tap. - ✅ **Clear notifications:** Big app icon; the title shows the source device and the app name. - ✅ **Pop-ups:** Notifications pop up on the tablet screen, even while you watch a video. - ✅ **Works while you use the phone**, not only when it is locked. - ✅ **Any Xiaomi account region:** EU, US, UA and other non-China accounts work on China ROMs. - ✅ **No duplicates:** Apps that are also installed on the tablet are skipped. - Languages: English, Türkçe, Русский, Español, 简体中文 ## Screenshots | Receive tab on the tablet | Every phone app, with icons | |---|---| | | | The tablet's system language is Turkish, so the lines XNotify adds are in Turkish; Xiaomi's own screen has no Turkish translation and stays in English. ## Requirements - A Xiaomi phone and a Xiaomi tablet on the HyperOS 4 China ROM (Android 17) - Both signed in to the same Xiaomi account, with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on - Root (KernelSU, SukiSU or Magisk) and LSPosed (API 102) on **both** devices Tested on Xiaomi 15 Ultra + Xiaomi Pad 8 Pro, and REDMI K90 Pro Max + Xiaomi Pad. ## Install 1. Install XNotify on **both** the phone and the tablet. 2. Enable it in LSPosed. The scope is `com.milink.service` (Interconnectivity) and System UI. 3. Reboot both devices. 4. On the tablet, open **Settings → Interconnectivity → Notifications → Receive**, tap your phone and turn on the apps you want. XNotify has no app icon or settings screen of its own. Everything is controlled from the tablet's notification settings. ## Source code and support - Source: https://github.com/Leekin2/XNotify (GPL-3.0) - Telegram channel: https://t.me/xioamifetiscisi - Feedback and suggestions: [@emcleek](https://t.me/emcleek) --- ## Türkçe **Xiaomi telefonunuzdaki tüm uygulamaların bildirimlerini Xiaomi tabletinizde görün.** HyperOS 4 Çin ROM'u için bir LSPosed modülü. ### Neden HyperOS telefon bildirimlerini tablette gösterebiliyor, ama üç sınırı var: - Yalnızca birkaç Çin uygulaması destekleniyor (WeChat, QQ, DingTalk…). - Çin tablet ROM'u **Al (Receive)** sekmesini gizliyor. Hangi telefondan ve hangi uygulamalardan bildirim alacağınızı bu sekmede seçiyorsunuz. - Sadece Çin'de kayıtlı Xiaomi hesaplarıyla çalışıyor. XNotify bu üç sınırı da kaldırır. ### Özellikler - ✅ **Tüm uygulamalar:** Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, SMS, aramalar ve telefonda kurulu diğer her şey. - ✅ **Al sekmesi açılır:** Tablette Ayarlar → Bağlantı → Bildirimler bölümünde artık **Al** sekmesi görünür. - ✅ **İkonlu uygulama seçici:** Telefon, uygulama listesini ve ikonlarını tablete gönderir. Telefona yeni uygulama kurduktan sonra sağ üstteki yenile simgesine dokunun. - ✅ **Arama ve hepsini kapat:** Uygulamayı adını yazarak bulun ya da tek dokunuşla hepsini kapatın. - ✅ **Anlaşılır bildirimler:** Büyük uygulama ikonu; başlıkta bildirimin geldiği cihaz ve uygulama adı yazar. - ✅ **Ekranda açılır:** Bildirimler tablette ekranın üstünde açılır, video izlerken bile. - ✅ **Telefonu kullanırken de çalışır**, sadece kilitliyken değil. - ✅ **Her bölgedeki Xiaomi hesabı:** AB, ABD, Ukrayna gibi Çin dışı hesaplar da Çin ROM'unda çalışır. - ✅ **Çift bildirim yok:** Tablette de kurulu olan uygulamaların bildirimleri tekrar gösterilmez. - Diller: English, Türkçe, Русский, Español, 简体中文 ### Ekran görüntüleri | Tablette Al sekmesi | Telefondaki tüm uygulamalar, ikonlarıyla | |---|---| | | | ### Gereksinimler - HyperOS 4 Çin ROM'lu (Android 17) bir Xiaomi telefon ve bir Xiaomi tablet - İkisi de aynı Xiaomi hesabına giriş yapmış, Wi-Fi ve Bluetooth açık - **İki cihazda da** root (KernelSU, SukiSU veya Magisk) ve LSPosed (API 102) Xiaomi 15 Ultra + Xiaomi Pad 8 Pro ve REDMI K90 Pro Max + Xiaomi Pad üzerinde test edildi. ### Kurulum 1. XNotify'ı telefona **ve** tablete kurun. 2. LSPosed'da etkinleştirin. Kapsam: `com.milink.service` (Bağlantı / Interconnectivity) ve System UI. 3. İki cihazı da yeniden başlatın. 4. Tablette **Ayarlar → Bağlantı → Bildirimler → Al** bölümünü açın, telefonunuza dokunun ve istediğiniz uygulamaları açın. XNotify'ın kendi ikonu veya ayar ekranı yoktur. Her şey tabletin bildirim ayarlarından yönetilir. ### Kaynak kod ve destek - Kaynak kod: https://github.com/Leekin2/XNotify (GPL-3.0) - Telegram kanalı: https://t.me/xioamifetiscisi - Öneri ve geri bildirim: [@emcleek](https://t.me/emcleek)
